name: Task_3
description: Build the reference dataset for the silver model. Use the supplied MACE-MP-0 teacher checkpoint with dispersion enabled. Make 45 isolated, nonperiodic Ag2 structures with separations from 0.6 Å to 5.0 Å in steps of 0.1 Å. Save every structure, its total energy in eV, and its complete atomic forces in eV/Å. Record the checkpoint identity and the calculator settings used.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide and fill in the required fields for this task. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
